QUESTION: Conditional on an already-present support state, does regular bullish divergence add practically meaningful trading value?
ESTIMAND_NOTE: A - B is the conditional incremental value of divergence inside support; it is not an interaction effect. The interaction stays a secondary mechanistic estimand.
WHY_ALLOWED: V0 was an outcome-blind feasibility calculation
this is a new research design, not a reinterpretation of the V0 verdict
2023-2024 is discovery/spent and treated as such
PANEL_AND_DETECTOR: same six symbols and unchanged SEED-0001 detector as V0; V0 per-symbol episode digests must reproduce; no panel expansion
PLANNED_INFERENCE: as V0: linear probability model with arm dummies (D reference) and symbol fixed effects, CR1 by panel-wide UTC week, t(G - 1); primary A - B two-sided alpha 0.05 with a positive estimate required

BASE.ROLE: one probit shock per UTC decision date shared by all symbols and arms

STRESS.ROLE: GATE: one shock per (UTC date, arm) shared across symbols; same-day same-arm episodes move together

COLLAPSED_PROFILE.ROLE: diagnostic lower bound: same-day same-arm episodes merged into one unit across symbols

FROZEN_RULES.GATE: STRESS power of A - B at 0.15, computed with 10000 replicates, >= 0.80 on BOTH proxy windows (first and last 85 weeks of the 2023-2024 layout)
FROZEN_RULES.HISTORICAL_ONLY: the gate on the two 85-week proxies of the spend window 2025-01-01..2026-08-11

COMBINED_DESIGN.SURFACE: spend window + prospective panel stream with decisions from 2026-10-05; prospective reads (klines, book baselines) start no earlier than 2026-08-27, after the E1 holdout
COMBINED_DESIGN.STAND_IN: each proxy is extended by w weeks cycled from the 2023-2024 layout with new week ids and shifted dates (no shared cluster or shock)
COMBINED_DESIGN.SEARCH: w on a 4-week grid from 0 to 156; screen with 4000 replicates; the first screened pass must be confirmed with 10000 replicates
COMBINED_DESIGN.STOPPING_RULE_FORM: stop at the first decision time when cumulative A episodes >= N_A AND cumulative A week clusters >= G_A (both taken from the more demanding proxy at its first confirmed pass), or at a deadline = 2026-10-05 + ceil(2 x expected weeks); below the thresholds at the deadline the result is INCONCLUSIVE with no extension
COMBINED_DESIGN.VARIANT_WITHOUT_BTC: the same search with BTC excluded from the prospective part, because the SEED-0001 prospective leg (BTC, from 2026-10-05) tests a near-identical A vs B contrast on the same episodes

FROZEN_RULES.CONTINUOUS_MODELS: not evaluated in V1; any graded/continuous primary needs its own frozen research object
FROZEN_RULES.PANEL_EXPANSION: not evaluated in V1; needs a fixed eligibility rule, PIT availability, liquidity/history and its own dependence and information-gain comparison
